entries.german: Thomas von Rosenberg und Sigmund von Thungen sagen im Namen ihres Schwagers Walter von Kranberg (Cranberg) dem Erzstift ab.
entries.english: Thomas von Rosenberg and Sigmund von Thungen declare on behalf of their brother-in-law Walter von Kranberg (Cranberg) against the archbishopric.

facts.content: declared a feud against the archbishopric on behalf of his Schwager Walter von Kranberg together with Sigmund von Thüngen.
